look_first: Inspect one flower and mature fruit, not the umbrella or head silhouette. Confirm inferior ovary, two styles on a stylopodium, and a schizocarp splitting into two one-seeded mericarps.

confusable.tie_breaker: Eryngium has individual 5-merous flowers and two-mericarpy fruit; Asteraceae has florets on a common receptacle inside phyllaries, typically an anther tube, and one cypsela per floret.

Project Hydrocotyle is creeping and node-rooting with peltate leaves and strongly flattened ribbed fruit; project Eryngium is upright and spiny with dense bracted heads. Do not rely on woody versus herbaceous.
